sessions.title: Reuse saved parameters
sessions.help: Loads dates, pair and initial capital only. The new run will not overwrite the saved session.

errors.range: End date must be after start date.
errors.future: End date must not be after today (UTC).
errors.capital: Enter initial capital of at least 100 USDT.
errors.start_failed: Could not start the backtest. Your parameters are retained; retry.
errors.load_failed: Could not load saved parameters. Current values are retained; retry.
